verdict.summary: OAR 0.35.0 is conditionally viable for an Environment-hosted Pi replacement with a bounded extension-loader hook; Codex is blocked from OAR production adoption and retains a bounded native exception; Claude is strictly not authorized for production Host-run and requires a named upstream/pre-dispatch native wrapper route under #225 prerequisites.

sharedAdapter.name: OarEngineAdapter
sharedAdapter.cardinality: single shared adapter parameterized by runtime identity, capability, and host policy
sharedAdapter.runnerSupervision: per-session supervised runner process group with explicit process-group timeout and isolation profile
sharedAdapter.seams: preserves existing Sprout EngineAdapter and EngineSession seams without leaking OAR Session types into durable records or Worker protocols
sharedAdapter.credentials: host-local credentials strictly preserved; no credential leakage to remote work origins or untrusted processes
sharedAdapter.placement: Environment-hosted placement retained for this slice; Host-run placement remains governed by #225

pi.route: OAR-based replacement via custom loader/extension hook under Environment-hosted mode; Native Host-run retained for #225
pi.evidenceLevel: model-issued (turn completion) / source-only (unbounded abort & post-abort wait) / scripted (process-group supervision)
pi.remedy: Upstream or runner-level Pi opener loader policy hook supplying strict tools/noTools options, disabling default native bash/ambient discovery, enforcing Worker-origin Project MCP transport, and bounded process-group supervision.
pi.acceptance: Demonstrate model-issued read/edit/command on isolated fixture with native tools unregistered/denied, ambient extensions excluded, and no host-stdio MCP execution; plus an OAR-specific abort/hung-close scenario verifying runner deadline enforcement followed by either Worker-confirmed remote termination or protected recovery state with lease retained and zero replay.

codex.route: Bounded Native Exception retained (src/engine/codex.ts / native app-server / exec-server); OAR Codex route blocked

nativeException.name: CodexNativeSeamException
nativeException.mechanism: Retain native Sprout EngineAdapter implementation for Codex
nativeException.removalTrigger: Upstream OAR release exposes typed executor binding (thread/start environments), dynamic-tool dispatch callbacks, and per-session sandbox isolation (decoupled from the runner's process environment OAR_CODEX_SANDBOX), tested and verified on Codex >= 0.159.3 without host-stdio MCP fallback or process-global sandbox pollution.

codex.remedy: Upstream OAR typed executor-binding option/hook and dynamic tool callback bridge; runner-level per-session sandbox posture decoupling.
codex.acceptance: Codex session starts with explicit remote Environment binding, issues model turns through Worker-origin tools, and refuses host sentinels without falling back to host execution.

claude.route: Future route gated on upstream #55 attribution fix, native pre-dispatch wrapper for builtin exclusion, and Human CLI installation/auth prerequisites; NOT authorized as production Host-run by #230
claude.evidenceLevel: model-issued (bounded local fixture with non-Claude backend; native nested Agent rejection observed)
prerequisites: Human-owned installation and authentication of Claude Code CLI on the engine host
Upstream #55 attribution resolution or verified projection hook preventing premature root completion
Native pre-dispatch exclusion wrapper (--bare, --tools '', approval denial for non-work tools)
Resolution of five unproved loader/policy boundaries (rules file read denial, automatic plugin discovery, LSP, managed policy, managed MCP)
claude.acceptance: Model-issued turn with genuine Claude backend verifying exact root-turn attribution, complete builtin exclusion, remote Worker MCP transport, and zero host leakage.

cumora.absorbedDesign: Engine run seam (EngineAdapter/EngineSession in src/engine/port.ts, ADR-0002)
cumora.deviations: none; OarEngineAdapter implements the exact port interface

paperclip.absorbedDesign: Separation of durable project workspace from per-work execution area (ADR-0005) and execution lifecycle from work status (ADR-0006)
paperclip.deviations: none; OAR operates strictly inside the per-work execution area without owning durable state

aionUi.referenceArea: Engine integration code (spawning, supervision, streaming, session handling; ADR-0016)
deviations: Single shared OarEngineAdapter parameterized across runtimes rather than AionUi per-CLI dedicated process controllers; native exception CodexNativeSeamException preserves AionUi-like native supervision for Codex
OAR intermediate vendor abstraction layer denied from leaking session or event types into Core or durable records
Strict remote Worker placement (ADR-0019) and OS sandbox boundary confinement rather than local user desktop authority

orderingAndSequencing.verdict: Governing order established via reconciliation reading: minimal Codex/Pi replacement precedes #225 engine-dependent delivery, while #225 substrate-independent work proceeds in parallel
orderingAndSequencing.reconciliationBasis: Ticket #230 AC7 and #226 require minimal replacement before #225's engine-dependent delivery; #253 ordering verdict noted replacement does not gate #225. Reconciled under Human adjudication: '#225's engine-dependent delivery' is read as the engine-dependent subset of #225. Substrate-independent #225 work proceeds immediately and in parallel, neither scope gates the other broadly, and #225 is neither amended nor closed.
rules: Minimal Codex/Pi replacement in Environment-hosted mode (Pi via shared OarEngineAdapter with loader hook, Codex via CodexNativeSeamException) strictly precedes #225's engine-dependent delivery.
Substrate-independent #225 work (startup parsing, durable placement facts, shared Environment operations Module in #237-#238) and the Pi vertical proceed in parallel and are never blocked.
Unrelated engine coverage (such as future Claude Host-run production support) follows both minimal replacement and #225 engine-dependent delivery.
Codex retains native exception in both modes until upstream OAR controls exist.
No broad runtime migration blocker: closing research issue #230 does not authorize production Host-run or unproven OAR routes, nor does it amend or close #225.
Downstream tickets #231-#236 are bounded planning drafts and must respect the blocked states and native exceptions recorded here.

upstreamDriftFinding.finding: OAR upstream has drifted from 0.35.0 to 0.58.0. In accordance with constraints, OAR is not floated or upgraded in this run scope. Upstream drift is recorded as a finding for future evaluation.

matrix.evidenceLevel: model-issued (turn completion) / source-only (unbounded abort & post-abort wait) / scripted (process-group supervision)
matrix.gapOrLimitation: Native abort and post-abort wait (promptAndWait) are unbounded in source; local process-group kill (140s/170s) does not prove remote operation stopped. Remote cancellation/fencing remains unproved in #227. Native Host-run recovery in #252 is partial and does not supply OAR evidence.
matrix.remedyOrPrerequisite: Bounded checkable acceptance: run an OAR-specific abort/hung-close scenario verifying the runner deadline takes effect, followed by either Worker-confirmed remote operation termination or a protected recovery state with lease retained and no replay; otherwise the OAR lifecycle route remains blocked.

conversationWithoutWorkEnvironment.evidence: #252 proved bounded PONG baseline on native Pi and Claude without Environment or leases; OAR route unproven for standalone no-env conversation.

enrolledRemoteOperationMcpOrigin.evidence: OAR 0.35.0 launches MCP stdio on the engine host (violating ADR-0019). #244/#245 proved Worker-origin HTTP/stdio MCP natively; OAR requires Sprout-managed HTTP MCP bridging or upstream remote-origin transport.

accessLeaseEnforcement.evidence: Task mutation leases enforced at Sprout runtime/operations layer; OAR carries no native lease concept.

staleBindingRejection.evidence: OAR cannot dynamically refresh tool bindings in-place (withdraw affects inputs only). Re-binding requires session disposal and fresh session creation, which rejects stale authority.

uncertainOperationRecovery.evidence: OAR abort() is only cancellation delivery, not remote-stop proof. Pi session disposal and post-abort wait are unbounded in source; local process-group kill does not prove remote termination. #252 native recovery is partial and does not supply OAR evidence. Blocked pending OAR-specific abort/hung-close scenario with Worker-confirmed remote termination or protected recovery state with lease retained and no replay.
